# Simulate three data sets from the same Vitality model

```{r setup}
library(failCompare)

set.seed(123)

# Simulates a dataset of size n from the vitality.ku model via inverse-CDF
# sampling: for each uniform draw p, solves S(t; r,s,k,u) = p for t using
# vitality::SurvFn.ku(), since vitality.ku has no built-in random generator.
sim_vitality <- function(n,params=NULL, r, s, k, u) {
  if(!is.null(params)){r=params[1];s=params[2];k=params[3];u=params[4]}
  p_draws <- stats::runif(n)
  sapply(p_draws, function(p) {
    upper <- 1
    while (vitality::SurvFn.ku(xx = upper, r = r, s = s, k = k, u = u) > p) {
      upper <- upper * 2
    }
    stats::uniroot(
      function(tt) vitality::SurvFn.ku(xx = tt, r = r, s = s, k = k, u = u) - p,
      interval = c(1e-8, upper)
    )$root
  })
}

# sample size per lot
n_size=45

sim_data_DF <- rbind(
  data.frame(lot="Lot 1", time=sim_vitality(n = n_size, params=c(0.014,0.0000004,0.004,0.04))),
  data.frame(lot="Lot 2", time=sim_vitality(n = n_size, params=c(0.014,0.0000004,0.004,0.04))),
  data.frame(lot="Lot 3", time=sim_vitality(n = n_size, params=c(0.014,0.0000004,0.004,0.04))))

par(mfrow=c(4,1),mar=c(3,2,1,1))
hist(sim_data_DF$time,xlim=range(sim_data_DF$time),main="pooled",breaks=seq(0,90,10))
invisible(sapply(1:3,function(x){
  lot_nm <- c("Lot 1","Lot 2","Lot 3")[x]
  hist(sim_data_DF$time[sim_data_DF$lot==lot_nm],xlim=range(sim_data_DF$time),main=lot_nm)
  return(NULL)}))


```

# Fit pooled and separate Vitality models and extract negative log likelihoods 


```{r LRT}

# Extract failure times by lot
lot1_data <- sim_data_DF$time[sim_data_DF$lot == "Lot 1"]
lot2_data <- sim_data_DF$time[sim_data_DF$lot == "Lot 2"]
lot3_data <- sim_data_DF$time[sim_data_DF$lot == "Lot 3"]
pooled_data <- sim_data_DF$time

pool_uncen_mod <- failCompare::fc_fit(pooled_data,model="vitality.ku")

pooled_nll <- pool_uncen_mod$nll

lot_specific_mod_ls <- list(
  "lot1"=failCompare::fc_fit(lot1_data,model="vitality.ku"),
  "lot2"=failCompare::fc_fit(lot2_data,model="vitality.ku"),
  "lot3"=failCompare::fc_fit(lot3_data,model="vitality.ku"))

tmp_tab <- t(sapply(lot_specific_mod_ls,function(x){data.frame(nll=x$"nll",nparams=nrow(x$"par_tab"))}))
tmp_par_tab <- lapply(lot_specific_mod_ls,function(x){data.frame(nll=x$"par_tab")})
nll_indiv <- unlist(tmp_tab[,"nll"])
n_param_v <- unlist(tmp_tab[,"nparams"])
diff_nll <- sum(nll_indiv)-pooled_nll
```

# Perform likelihood ratio test

```{r fitting}
chisq_stat  <- 2*diff_nll
df_v <- sum(n_param_v)-nrow(pool_uncen_mod$"par_tab")
p_value <- pchisq(chisq_stat, df = df_v, lower.tail = FALSE)

data.frame(sep_nll=sum(nll_indiv),pooled_nll,Chi_2=chisq_stat,df=df_v,"p-value"=p_value)

```
